summary.text: Murrell Smith is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 67, who assumed office in 2000 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to Ballotpedia, he was elected speaker of the House on April 28, 2022, and re-elected to the position in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Smith was born in 1968 in Florence, South Carolina, and received a Bachelor of Arts degree from Wofford College in 1990 and a Juris Doctorate from the University of South Carolina School of Law in 1993, according to Ballotpedia.
He worked as a public defender and for several private law firms, and was the owner of Reliable Medical Equipment.
Smith was elected to the South Carolina House in 2000 to represent District 68 and was elected to represent District 67 in 2002.
Ballotpedia says he chaired the Ways and Means Committee from 2018 to 2022 and became chair of the House Ethics Committee in 2018.
He was elected speaker of the House on April 28, 2022, began his term on May 12, 2022, and was elected speaker again in 2024.
